question: Orb of Dreams says 'Permanents enter tapped.' Does Orb of Dreams itself enter the battlefield tapped?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it can't affect itself, so it enters untapped.
expected.answer: Orb of Dreams is an artifact that says “Permanents enter tapped.” It won’t affect itself, so Orb of Dreams enters the battlefield untapped.
